components.name: API Gateway
components.purpose: Entry point for all rider and driver requests.

components.name: Trip Service
components.purpose: Manages the complete lifecycle of a trip.

components.name: Location Service
components.purpose: Receives and stores real-time driver GPS updates.

components.name: Matching Service
components.purpose: Finds the most suitable nearby driver.

components.name: ETA Service
components.purpose: Calculates estimated pickup and travel times.

components.name: Notification Service
components.purpose: Sends trip updates and push notifications.

components.name: Redis
components.purpose: Caches active driver locations and frequently accessed trip data.

components.name: Kafka
components.purpose: Processes asynchronous trip events and notifications.

components.name: Geospatial Index
components.purpose: Indexes driver locations using Geohash or H3.

components.name: Database
components.purpose: Stores users, drivers, trips and payment records.
